verdict.rationale: Large-table extraction with intelligent chunking is a fair question for a scraping and extraction API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only general extraction features (extract_rules CSS/XPath selectors, ai_query semantic extraction, markdown output). Nothing in the pack shows chunking of very large tables to fit within processing limits.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract data from very large tables using intelligent chunking so it fits within processing limits
